title: SourceLocator
description: WHERE in a source a value was drawn from. payloadDigest answers 'is this the same payload'; it cannot answer 'which passage did this come from', so without a locator a reader cannot check a claim against its source without re-deriving the whole document. provenanceVersion states the grade actually carried, so a document-only locator is never mistaken for a located one. Absent means the emitter recorded no position at all — a weaker claim than recording 'document-only', because it is silent about whether a position was even available. Extracted from the pattern-warrant apparatus as a standalone type so any schema that carries a provenance reference can compose the same grade, not just EvidenceAtom.

provenanceVersion.description: document-only: the source is identified, the position within it is not. chunk-ordinal: an index into a chunking, which resolves only if that chunking is reproduced identically — it points into a derived artifact, not into the source. character-span: a half-open [start,end) range over the extracted text, resolvable without re-running the chunker.

sourceRef.description: Identifier of the source document the position is relative to.

extractionDigest.description: Digest of the extracted text the offsets index into. The same document extracted by a different pipeline yields different offsets, so a verifier must be able to confirm it holds the same extraction before trusting a span.
